description: Agent-based social adoption diffusion on a dynamic contact network with peer effects, media shocks, and policy interventions. The model simulates individuals deciding whether to adopt a behavior/technology over time, influenced by neighbors, media intensity, and policy incentives.

modules.name: NetworkBuilder
modules.description: Constructs the initial contact network with target average degree, clustering, and mild group assortativity.

update_rule.pseudocode:
function build_network(population_size, avg_degree, clustering_target, assortativity_by_group, degree_dispersion, group_shares):
  # Step 1: assign groups per group_shares
  assign group_id to each person by multinomial(group_shares)
  # Step 2: sample degrees from lognormal with mean approx avg_degree and dispersion degree_dispersion
  target_degrees = sample_lognormal_constrained(population_size, avg_degree, degree_dispersion) ensuring even sum
  # Step 3: build initial configuration model graph
  G = configuration_model(target_degrees)
  remove_parallel_edges_and_self_loops(G)
  # Step 4: increase clustering via triadic closure until clustering_target
  while clustering_coefficient(G) < clustering_target and iterations < max_iter:
    pick node u with degree>1, pick two neighbors v,w not connected, add edge (v,w) and remove a random non-triangle edge to keep degree distribution stable
    iterations += 1
  # Step 5: introduce assortativity by group via edge swaps
  do N_swaps = floor(assortativity_by_group * |E|):
    pick edges (u,v) and (x,y)
    if swapping endpoints increases proportion of same-group edges, perform swap
  return G, stats
notes: Uses configuration model then targeted triadic closure to reach clustering_target.
Assortativity is induced by degree-preserving edge swaps.
tick_rate 0 means run once during initialization.

modules.name: ContactDynamics
modules.description: Evolves the network over time with contact decay, homophilic rewiring, and triadic closure.

notes: Maintains dynamic social structure influenced by homophily and closure.
Operates after NetworkBuilder and before BehaviorAdoption each day.

modules.name: MediaPolicy
modules.description: Generates daily media intensity signals and applies policy incentives/penalties based on schedule and eligibility.

notes: Media shock is a one-day increase; can be tuned by magnitude.
Eligibility sampled daily to approximate staggered rollout.

modules.name: BehaviorAdoption
modules.description: Implements individual adoption decisions using a logistic model with peer, media, and policy influences, and allows limited backsliding.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each day t:
  candidates = []
  for each person i not yet adopted and not stubborn:
    peer_frac = fraction_of_neighbors_adopted(i)
    x = logit(base_adoption_rate) + peer_influence_weight * (peer_frac - threshold[i]) + media_influence_weight * media_intensity[i] + policy_influence_weight * policy_effect[i] + Normal(0, decision_noise_scale)
    p = sigmoid(x)
    if rand() < p: candidates.append(i)
  # Saturation cap
  max_new = floor(adoption_saturation_limit_daily * count_non_adopters())
  new_adopters = random_sample(candidates, size=min(len(candidates), max_new))
  for i in new_adopters: state[i] = Adopted; adoption_time[i] = t
  # Backsliding
  for each person j currently Adopted:
    if rand() < backslide_rate: state[j] = NotAdopted; adoption_time[j] = null
notes: Logistic with centered peer influence vs individual threshold.
Saturation cap prevents unrealistic surges when parameters are extreme.

modules.name: AggregationObserver
modules.description: Aggregates daily observables for comparison with data and downstream metrics.

notes: Smoothing does not affect internal dynamics; only reported observables.
Backsliders are implicitly accounted for via current state snapshots.

algorithms.configuration_model_with_closure: Initial network generation via configuration model followed by triadic closure adjustments to reach target clustering.
algorithms.degree_preserving_edge_swaps: Edge swaps to induce assortativity without changing node degrees.
algorithms.dynamic_rewiring: Daily edge decay and homophilic/closure-based rewiring.
algorithms.logistic_adoption: Individual adoption probability via logistic function of peer, media, and policy signals.
algorithms.saturation_capping: Daily cap on number of new adopters to prevent unrealistic surges.
algorithms.moving_average: Smoothing observed series for reporting only.
